subject: Dynamic UI with multiple variable output

messages.author: 82ff128d4e688f15
messages.subject: Dynamic UI with multiple variable output
parts:
Hey there,

I am amazed by the dynamic UI. Its great and I wonder how much I can do with it.

My goal:
I upload a CSV file with x independent variables. Then x sliderinputs should be added, which min/max values etc. are 
dependent of the data.

What I accomplished so far:
x sliderinputs are automatically added. 

My problem:
However, I do not manage to make min/max values etc. dependent of the data.

My approach:
I am actually surprised it worked. I just used rep() to produce multiple sliderInputs, see the code below. 
But how can I assign individual values to min/max. I tried to create an object x=rep(0, DimData()) and assign
individual sliderInput with a for loop to x, which of course didnt work ;)
But I dont really know what kind of an object I require, since I dont know what a vector of sliderinputs is for a object.
Or in general whether my approach was just stupid luck so far.

Thanks for your responses!
Tonio



  output$ui <- renderUI({
    x = rep(sliderInput("Speed", "Speed:", min = 0, max = 10000, value = 1000, step = 10), DimData())
    x
  })

  DimData <- reactive({
      data = as.matrix(read.csv(Upload()$datapath, header = TRUE, sep = ";"))
      dim(data)[2] - 1
  })

Upload() returns the uploaded csv-file.

And note that lapply also works well (i.e. just a regular list). (If renderUI doesn't like accepting an lapply result directly, you can also wrap the result of lapply in tagList, that will definitely work.)

See a demo of this at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XfEvsu4_zaE from about 17:00-18:45. And for why tagList exists, see 19:05.
